messages.text:
The refund can’t be sent to your sister’s bank account; refunds go only to the order’s original payment, and the shop can’t redirect one to another account. (refund-policy/v2/payment)

I’ve proposed BRL 149.65 for the returned Bluetooth speaker. If you’d like to proceed to the original payment, confirm the exact proposal using the button on its card; a chat message won’t confirm it. (refund-policy/v2/amount)
